title: Trillanes arrives at Senate for Sara Duterte impeachment trial
summary: Former senator Antonio “Sonny” Trillanes IV on Tuesday arrived at the Senate to attend the 31st hearing of Vice President Sara Duterte"s impeachment trial.

blocks.text: Former senator Antonio “Sonny” Trillanes IV on Tuesday arrived at the Senate to attend the 31st hearing of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.
As of Sunday, Trillanes has yet to be issued a subpoena by the Senate impeachment court.

He will attend as a guest on the day that Davao Mayor Sebastian "Baste" Duterte will take the witness stand to testify on Article II, which alleges that the Vice President accumulated unexplained wealth. —KG, GMA News
